verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a public cloud and edge-hosting platform, so default DDoS protection and a web application firewall are a fair thing for a buyer to ask about. However, no evidence item documents either capability. The global Anycast network (fly-io-docs-20), Sprite egress policies and hardware-isolated VMs are related networking and isolation features, not DDoS mitigation or WAF filtering of inbound requests, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can have DDoS protection and a web application firewall applied to every request by default
